verdict.rationale: Jeeves explicitly positions itself as a consolidated platform combining corporate cards, expense management, global/cross-border payments, bill pay, and multi-currency banking accounts under one product, with a direct marketing claim of replacing multiple point solutions (jeeves-docs-48). Evidence spans cards (docs-1,18-21), expense management (docs-3,6,22-24,37), global payments/bill pay (docs-2,26-30,39,45), and banking/cash accounts (docs-5,25,38,40-41), showing broad functional overlap of a typical finance stack. Missing for 10: independent/customer case studies confirming actual consolidation in practice, and clearer detail on bill pay/AP automation depth versus dedicated tools.
